Source contracts: install.sh

install.sh

Shell · Tier B

Install controller dependencies and update the applicable local Gateway environment.

Usage

Prepare Linux/macOS startup prerequisites; rerun after source updates.

Inputs

PYTHON_BIN selects Python 3.11+; AOR_SKIP_SYSTEM_DEPS/AOR_INSTALL_SYSTEM_DEPS control system packages; AOR_INSTALL_NO_BUILD omits build extras; AOR_SKIP_GATEWAY_SETUP skips local Gateway setup; AOR_SKIP_UI_BUILD skips rebuilding web interface bundles whose sources changed.

Side effects

Can install OS/Python packages, recreate incompatible root .venv, update local Gateway .venv, and install browser/developer components. Network/package-manager permissions are required when installation runs.

Cleanup

Normally exits after setup; its optional start path execs startup.sh. Remote hosts and existing service restarts remain operator-owned.
